strategy_roster.name: N Trades Per Set Martingale
strategy_roster.notes: The EA opens a new long immediately after the previous one closes and only manages martingale sizing, per-set resets and the equity-increase exit, so there is no market-derived entry to translate and the never-true guard is used. Pip stop/take-profit, Scale Factor, Equity Divisor and the equity reset are not DSL signals.

strategy_roster.name: No Nonsense Tester
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,20),ema(close,40)) and rsi(close,14) > 60 and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),50)
strategy_roster.notes: The NNFX baseline plus two confirmations is rendered as an EMA(20)/EMA(40) cross with RSI(14) above 60 and ATR(14) above its own average; the exit RSI lower level closes. Every documented threshold is a parameter name without a value (20/40, 60/40 and ATR 14 are fallbacks) and the ATR-scaled brackets, trailing and volume multiplier are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Option Expiration Week
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is purely calendar based (buy the Monday before the third Friday, close Friday's close, otherwise hold cash), so no price-derived entry exists and the never-true guard is used. The expiration-week window and the MinTradeUsd order-size check are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Technical Rank
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) > 70 and roc(close,10) > 0 and ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: rsi(close,14) < 30 and roc(close,10) < 0 and ema(close,20) < ema(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: The weighted composite rank (MA, ROC, PPO slope, RSI) is approximated by unanimity of RSI above 70, positive ROC(10), EMA(20)>EMA(50) and MACD above signal for rank>70, mirrored for rank<30 on the exit. Component periods are not documented (10/20/50 and 12/26/9 are fallbacks) and the docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Exp MAMA
strategy_roster.notes: MESA MAMA/FAMA cannot be computed, so the adaptive pair is approximated by a 5/34 EMA pair, keeping the documented contrarian rule that MAMA crossing below FAMA opens the long. FastLimit/SlowLimit values, the Buy/Sell toggles and the timeframe choice are not documented and market orders use no stops.

strategy_roster.name: MM Fibonacci
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,10) and close > donchian_low(low,10) + 0.5 * (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10))
strategy_roster.notes: The 100% Murrey level becomes the 10-bar Donchian high (length not documented) and the most-recent-extreme-is-a-high condition is checked by requiring the break close above the 50% midpoint; the documented exit is the mirror 50% break. The internal Murrey grid below the 50% level is not expressible and docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Hans123 Trader
strategy_roster.notes: The rolling RangeLength 80 channel is kept as the Donchian breakout and its mirror close; pending stop-order placement inside the 06:00-10:00 window is replaced by the close-based break. The 50-pip stop/target, 10-pip trailing and 5-pip step are pip distances, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: RPM5 BullsBearsEyes
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,13) and high - ema(close,13) > 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,5)
strategy_roster.notes: Bulls Power from the 13-period EMA is tested against the documented Threshold 0.5 scaled by ATR(5) instead of the four-stage Gamma 0.5 smoother, with price above the EMA confirming the bullish bias. The 25/150-pip brackets and the 1.5xATR(5) trailing are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Random ATR Strategy - Bybit
strategy_roster.notes: The entry is a pseudo-random signal seeded from recent price ranges and the current date, so no deterministic market condition can be derived and the never-true guard is used rather than inventing one. The ATR(14) 3x/3x1 stop-target pair is ATR-distanced, not a fixed percentage.

strategy_roster.name: MFI Strategy with Oversold Zone Exit and Averaging
strategy_roster.notes: MFI is approximated by volume-weighted RSI(14): the documented MfiOversoldLevel 20 recross with volume above its 20-bar average opens the long, and StartProtection supplies the documented 1% stop and 1% target. The 0.1% limit-buy offset, the 5-bar cancel window and averaging orders are not expressible; the mean-reversion exit uses an RSI recross above 50.
